description: Copy the bundled RPG Maker skill files (workflow guides for map building, event writing, balancing, localization, plugins) into the project's .claude/skills folder so Claude Code picks them up automatically in that project. The same files are always available as resources (rpgmaker://skills/<name>). Existing skill folders are skipped unless overwrite=true.

overwrite.description: Replace skill files that already exist

name: install_skills
title: Install skill files
